description: This file defines request handlers for cron-related operations in a gateway server, including listing, adding, updating, removing, and running cron jobs, as well as fetching their statuses and execution logs.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Handles wake requests, triggering a wake operation with specified mode and text.

methods.name: cron.list
methods.description: Lists cron jobs with optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: cron.status
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of cron jobs.

methods.name: cron.add
methods.description: Adds a new cron job after normalization and validation.

methods.name: cron.update
methods.description: Updates an existing cron job identified by id or jobId.

methods.name: cron.remove
methods.description: Removes a cron job by id or jobId.

methods.name: cron.run
methods.description: Enqueues a run for a specific cron job.

methods.name: cron.runs
methods.description: Fetches execution logs for cron jobs, either all or specific to a job.
